name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
description: The green stdio suite, probe and store check yielded gate-attempt-passed with 30 seconds, one poll, answered on poll 1 and answered as the context. There were no gate-refusal effects, and the run passed with its cycle.
